name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
